title: MF-EDA: Joining Membership Functions to Adapt the Number of Distributions in Gaussian Estimation-of-Distribution Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2611.30436v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An estimation-of-distribution algorithm (EDA) usually samples from one Gaussian, whose peak sits where most selected individuals are. On a landscape with two funnels that is not where the best solutions are: the wider funnel supplies most of the selected individuals, and the deeper funnel, which holds the global optimum, is lost early. This paper builds the search distribution as a neuro-fuzzy system builds a model: from Gaussian membership functions joined by membership degrees. In every generation the proposed MF-EDA searches the principal directions of the selected individuals for the direction along which they are bimodal, describes them on that direction by one or two membership functions according to the Bayesian information criterion and a separation test, joins each membership function to a local Gaussian in the other directions, and samples from the normalised union. translated_title: MF-EDA：在Gaussian分布估计算法中通过隶属函数的连接来自适应分布数量
translated_abstract: 一个分布估计算法（EDA）通常从单个Gaussian分布中采样，该分布的峰值位于大多数被选中个体的所在处。在具有两个漏斗的地形上，这并不是最优解所在之处：较宽的漏斗提供了大部分被选中的个体，而包含全局最优解的较深漏斗则在早期就丢失了。本文像神经模糊系统构建模型那样来构建搜索分布：由通过隶属度连接起来的Gaussian隶属函数构成。在每一代中，所提出的MF-EDA在被选中个体的主方向上搜索它们呈双峰性的方向，根据贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）和分离性检验，在该方向上用一个或两个隶属函数来描述这些个体，将每个隶属函数与其他方向上的局部Gaussian分布相连接，并从归一化后的并集中采样。无论数量多少，每个隶属函数的高度均为一……
tldr: 提出MF-EDA算法，像神经模糊系统一样通过由隶属度连接的Gaussian隶属函数构建搜索分布，并借助贝叶斯信息准则和分离性检验自适应确定分布数量，从而在双漏斗地形上避免过早丢失包含全局最优解的深漏斗。
en_tdlr: MF-EDA builds the search distribution from Gaussian membership functions joined by membership degrees—like a neuro-fuzzy system—and adapts the number of distributions via the Bayesian information criterion and a separation test, avoiding the early loss of the deeper funnel that holds the global optimum on two-funnel landscapes.
